notes: kb/Work PB5925 (listing step 4b of docs/rearchitecture/DESIGN-listing.md, 2026-11-18), judged by the 2002 text. The compiler produces a source listing on request at --std 2002 (cobol --listing; DOC-A.1-117, B.1 item 90), so §2002:7.2.15.2 GR1's "Otherwise, the following general rules apply" holds and the row is decided by the listing. GR3: "Each LISTING directive shall be listed, even if the listing is being suppressed by a LISTING directive." Each LISTING directive's line is recorded (TextStageTrace.ListingDirective) and listed whatever the state; the witness's second '>>LISTING OFF', met under OFF, is listed and printed.
